notes.zh-CN: 新增 302.AI Media Studio CLI 支持：可在聊天、Bot、定时任务和飞书中选择 302.AI，支持登录引导、独立会话与恢复、图片和本地文件输入、媒体结果展示。发送任务前沿用 GrokX 权限审批；不自动重试生成。需要 Node.js 22+ 及已登录的 msc（已核对官方 CLI 0.1.8）。真实付费生成未执行。macOS 为 universal，开发签名未公证；Windows 安装包未签名；APK 沿用上一版 debug 签名；IPA 为开发签名，仅限团队已注册设备。
notes.en: Add 302.AI Media Studio CLI as a selectable agent for chats, Bots, schedules and Feishu. Includes terminal login guidance, isolated resumable sessions, image/local file input and media results. Tasks use GrokX approval and are never retried automatically. Requires Node.js 22+ and an authenticated msc installation; checked against official CLI 0.1.8. No paid generation was run. macOS is universal and development-signed, not notarized; Windows installers are unsigned; APK retains the prior debug signing identity; IPA is development-signed for registered team devices.
